definitions.explanation: A cutting technique where ingredients are sliced into thin, matchstick-like strips. Creates uniform strips typically 4-5cm long and 2-3mm thick.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{千切|せんぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{千切|せんぎ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Add julienned daikon to the salad.

examples.japanese: ⟦とんかつ→とんかつ：28094_tonkatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千切|せんぎ}り⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Shredded cabbage is standard with tonkatsu.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧ (thousand) + {切|ぎ}り (cutting)

Literally "thousand cuts" - referring to the many thin strips created.

CUTTING TECHNIQUE:
Ingredients are first sliced thinly, then stacked and cut into thin strips (2-3mm wide, 4-5cm long). Results in matchstick-shaped pieces.

COMMON INGREDIENTS:
- ⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧ - cabbage (most common)
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}→大根：05186_daikon⟧ - daikon radish
- ⟦{人参|にんじん}→人参：05185_ninjin⟧ - carrot
- きゅうり - cucumber
- しょう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ - ginger

COMMON PATTERN:
「〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{千切|せんぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧」 - to julienne ~

CLASSIC COMBINATION:
{千切|せんぎ}り⟦キャベツ→キャベツ：05187_kyabetsu⟧ is the standard garnish for:
- ⟦とんかつ→とんかつ：28094_tonkatsu⟧ (pork cutlet)
- ⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧ (croquette)
- ⟦エビフライ→エビフライ：28710_ebifurai⟧ (fried shrimp)

RELATED CUTTING TERMS:
- ⟦みじん{切|ぎ}り→みじん切り：07472_mijingiri⟧ - minced
- ⟦{薄切|うすぎ}り→薄切り：07475_usugiri⟧ - thinly sliced
- ⟦{短冊切|たんざくぎ}り→短冊切り：08087_tanzakugiri⟧ - rectangle cut
